verdict.rationale: Notte is an AI browser-automation platform, so an in-product AI insights feature is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence only documents LLM-powered extraction of web pages into structured data and agents that run natural-language tasks. Neither is AI-generated insight or suggestion drawn from the user's own data inside the product, so that evidence is adjacent at best.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
